name: Rainbow Pairs
summary: Bracket and quote pairs in depth colors · jump to pair / sibling / parent / child (WASM · replaces the built-in copy)
description: Colors every bracket/quote pair by nesting depth so pairs can be told apart at a glance, marks unmatched ones, and adds navigation: matching pair (Ctrl+M), previous/next sibling (Ctrl+Alt+, / .), parent (Ctrl+Alt+[), first child (Ctrl+Alt+]), plus a 'Bracket Navigation' submenu in the editor context menu. This package is the WASM build of the extension made with the SDK in extensions/sdk (samples/rainbow-pairs): installing downloads rainbow_pairs.wasm, verifies its sha256 and loads it in the app's wasmi sandbox (fuel · memory · time limits); it replaces the built-in copy of the same id, which stays as a fallback if the module cannot be loaded. Pair kinds, pairs inside strings, the current-pair underline and auto-close are core editor settings (editor.pair_*); this extension only adds the depth colors (rainbowpair.*).
author: SosomLab
